description: Bucket of scraped/compiled data on major businesses handling big (primarily government/defense) contracts, their current status, and locations.

top_contractors_last_12mo.status_summary: Record backlog $292B (Q3 2026). F-35 multi-year framework (~850 aircraft). PAC-3 MSE $52.5B. FY2026 sales guidance $80-82B. Strong growth.
Top missile/radar/engine contractor. Recent SM-6, SPY-6, F135 sustainment awards. Strong demand.

top_contractors_last_12mo.hq_location: Global: Arlington VA (929 Long Bridge Drive); Defense: St. Louis area (moved 2026)
top_contractors_last_12mo.status_summary: KC-46 ongoing. New fighter programs (F-47, F/A-XX). Improved contract types for risk. Defense HQ relocated closer to production.
Major VA and health-related federal contracts.
Submarines via Electric Boat (often top in FY2026 provisional). Tanks, IT services.
Space, B-21, unmanned systems, radars. Ongoing awards.

trends.hq_clustering: Most defense primes headquartered in Northern Virginia / DC metro for customer proximity.
trends.relocation_note: Broader corporate trend to Texas (DFW, Austin, Houston); defense firms largely remain near DC. Boeing shifted defense HQ to St. Louis in 2026.
trends.contract_climate: High DoD spending. Multi-year and IDIQ awards common. Focus on munitions, sustainment, ships, aircraft, IT, border infrastructure.

disclaimer: Public data snapshot. Obligations net of deobligations. FY2026 provisional. Verify with primary sources for decisions.
